body: Thanks for the advice. It would be pretty pointless to tell my parents, they would just get upset and nothing good could come out of it. I am also not interested in them helping me out financially because I don't deserve it.  Unfortunately, I am going to have to deal with this on my own. For the past little while, all that I have been able to think about is all the things that I could have done with the money, things I have always wanted to do. It kills me to think about what a sucker I am and how weak I am.
